content.en_US:
Heavy water can be filtered out of regular water using a [[deuterium extractor|Deuterium Extractor]] at a rate of 2% (1mB of heavy water per 50mB regular water). It is primarily used as an intermediate for making [[deuterium|Deuterium]].

It can also be used as a coolant in the [[PWR]], where it grants a +25% flux bonus.
